tips.title: Assembling Trumpeter/Airfix Multi-Part Gun Barrels
tips.text: Begin by dry-fitting gun barrel sections to ensure a good fit. Use a fine needle file to remove any excess material or flash from the mating surfaces. Apply a touch of Tamiya Extra Thin Cement along the joint, joining the parts quickly. Hold them together for a few seconds to ensure a strong bond. Allow 24 hours to cure before painting.

tips.title: Aligning Wings with a Simple Jig
tips.text: For alignment during construction, create a simple jig using scrap plastic or cardboard. Mark and cut out a 'T' shape that fits into the wing's root and a slot for the fuselage's bottom. Before gluing, place the jig in position, ensuring both wings are level and parallel to the fuselage. Apply glue sparingly along the join and allow to set.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: Before installing Eduard photo-etch parts, bend them gently using a GodHand nipper or tweezers. Apply a light touch of CA glue to the back of the part, let it wick in slightly, then position and hold in place until set. Use a magnifying glass for precise placement. After installation, paint and weather as usual.

tips.title: Working with Clear Prop Models Resin Conversions
tips.text: Sand resin parts with 150 grit sandpaper to remove any rough edges or flashing. Apply a 50/50 mixture of water and dish soap to the parts to remove any mold release agent. Assemble parts using CA glue, applying a small amount to one surface, letting it wick in slightly, then joining the parts and holding them until set. Allow 24 hours cure time before painting.

tips.title: Assembling Arma Hobby Tracks: Individual Links vs. Vinyl
tips.text: For individual links, clean up any molding lines with a sharp knife or sandpaper. Use Vallejo Plastic Putty to fill any gaps, allowing it to dry completely before sanding smooth. Glue tracks together using Tamiya Extra Thin Cement, applying sparingly along the join and allowing 24 hours cure time. For vinyl tracks, clean up any excess material, then soak in warm water to remove any residual mold release. Glue individual links together using CA glue, allowing 1 hour cure time.
